Title: Register an account at DRAC
Description: In this video, you’ll learn how to register a DRAC account with the Digital Research Alliance of Canada. We walk through the sign-up process, the key information you’ll need, and what to do after your account is created so you’re ready to request access to services.
Author: Jiarui Li
Prerequisites: No previous skills or experience required

Title: Introduction To Digital Research Alliance of Canada (DRAC)
Description: New to DRAC? This short intro explains what the Digital Research Alliance of Canada (DRAC) is, who it’s for, and what you can do with it. Learn the basics of accounts, access, and where to go next so you can start using national research computing resources with confidence.
Author: Jiarui Li
Prerequisites: No previous skills or experience required

Title: Job Performance Evaluation
Description: This video shows how to evaluate whether your job used resources effectively. We look at the kinds of indicators that help you diagnose slow runs, reduce wasted CPU/GPU time, and request more appropriate resources for future submissions.
Author: Jiarui Li
Prerequisites: No previous skills or experience required

Title: Submit The Batch Job
Description: This video introduces the batch scheduler workflow on DRAC: what a job script is, what you typically need to specify, and how to submit and monitor jobs. The goal is to help you move from interactive testing to reliable batch runs.
Author: Jiarui Li
Prerequisites: No previous skills or experience required

Title: Software Module On DRAC HPC Clusters
